citationText: U.S. Army Research Institute for the Behavioral and Social Sciences, “Introduction to and Review of Simulator Sickness Research,” April 2005, http://www.dtic.mil/cgi-bin/GetTRDoc?AD=ADA434495.Philip Lelyveld, program manager, USC Entertainment Technology Center, runs the VR/AR Initiative at the USC Entertainment Technology Center. He recently brought communities of hands-on practitioners together to discuss and document the state of the emerging language of VR storytelling and live VR production workflow. Lelyveld also consults on product strategy and business development to consumer electronics multinationals and startups. He can be reached at plelyveld@etcenter.org.
